g.title: Part1a
g.text: Part 1a — Architecture A, redrawn (Option A: inline outcomes)
The CUGA loop IS the daemon (one OS process). Bus carries TRIGGERS in. Outcomes go straight out via MCP tools.
No separate pub_sinks layer. Email/Slack/etc. are just tools the agent calls.

g.title: cluster_reg
g.text: — configuration. NO events. Read at startup & on config change.

g.title: cluster_cugaloop
g.text: — one long-running OS process (uvicorn). Hosts everything below.

g.title: cluster_triggers
g.text: (inside the CUGA loop — watch for things)

g.title: cluster_bus
g.text: — for INCOMING triggers only. Outcomes do NOT go through here.

g.title: cluster_agents
g.text: — stateless async functions. Invoked on demand. No while-True.

g.title: mcp
g.text: called over network. Outcomes use these too.
